name: BSCW World Championship
epitaph: Philippe LaFleur won it in February 2001 with a referee Rick Sturgis had paid, and Justin Keith was carrying it by May, when Taurus took it from him two falls to one in the Detonation main event. Keith won it back at Ragnarok that September as the first three-time champion the fed had billed, then lost it to "Deadly" Derek Irvin in a ladder match at Ascension, with his late brother's honorary belt hanging beside it.

name: BSCW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Hellz Angelz won it from Da Old Timerz at Viking Hall in February 2001; Gemini held it through Detonation, and the Q's lost it to Debonair in a loser-leaves-town triple threat at Ragnarok. Whiskey Jakk and Derek Irvin became champions by surviving the Thunderdome at Hostile Intentions, and Hell On Earth took it from them at The Process of Weeding Out when Jakk left his partner to be pinned.

name: BSCW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Contested in an eight-man Royal Rumble at Viking Hall in February 2001 and won by the rookie Matt Maelstrom, who was being called a former champion by May.

name: BSCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: X-Kalibur's reign was cut short by Leo in May 2001, and Leo kept it through a sixty-minute triple threat Iron Man match at Detonation. By August it was "Deadly" Derek Irvin's until John O'Riordan beat him, and that autumn a tournament decided it, won by Shrapnel over Tyson Bryson at The Process of Weeding Out.

name: BSCW United States Championship
epitaph: Andrew Sampson, a two-time champion, lost it to Max C at Detonation 2001 and left the fed that night. Johnny Spades held it by August, until Greed beat him backstage and Grinnin pinned him with the Gobsmacker.

name: BSCW Canadian Championship
epitaph: J.C. Swinger won it while vacant in May 2001 and lost it, with his unbeaten run, to Goo at Detonation. Taurus, already World Champion, made Goo submit for it that August, and by October the fed's roster was saying the title was gone.

name: BSCW Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Vic "Tim Dogg" Simmons held it through Detonation 2001 with a splash onto a steel grocery cart. Sykopath kept it through a Detroit Death Match, a Helter Skelter match and a Taipei Death Match before Richard Harris took it from him at The Process of Weeding Out by leaping off the balcony of Viking Hall.

name: BSCW North American Championship
epitaph: Introduced at Ragnarok in September 2001, where Max C won it first and lost it the same night to Matt Wilson's impromptu rematch. Wilson never came back, the title was held up at Hostile Intentions, and Todd Royal won it in a rumble at The Process of Weeding Out by tying his bootlace to the bottom rope.
